mode: actual Windows packaged debug EXE, WebView2/Konva, SQLite and native Save/Open; isolated generated PNG, not physical capture/DPI validation
checks: actual canvas click creates a stable point anchor in original pixels with title/description and verified original SHA256
actual rectangle drawing saves a bounded original-pixel region; point and rectangle have distinct IDs
dragging an existing marker opens confirmation; saving moves it without changing its stable ID
marker visibility and actual canvas zoom leave stored original-pixel coordinates unchanged
actual screenshot/anchor picker inserts two stable references at the caret and native Markdown Save writes exact source
click opens the actual image editor, centers rendered yellow marker pixels, and preserves unsaved Markdown source/status
split resizing and consecutive region/point jumps retain source and latest target; highlight expires after three seconds
annotation version changes retain the original image revision; mismatched image revision and arbitrary-path IDs are rejected
native standard Markdown export replaces proprietary anchor URLs with readable coordinates and description without modifying source
confirmed anchor deletion retains source text and yields an explicit broken-reference error rather than another location
actual process restart preserves surviving anchor/ID/region, deleted reference in saved source, new annotation version and immutable original hash
